scripts.build:sidecar: bun run build:workflow && bun -e 'import { chmodSync, copyFileSync, mkdirSync, rmSync } from "node:fs"; mkdirSync("resources/darwin-arm64/bin/workflow-runtime", { recursive: true }); rmSync("resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-bun", { force: true }); rmSync("resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-agent.js", { force: true }); copyFileSync(process.execPath, "resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-bun"); chmodSync("resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-bun", 0o755); for (const f of ["flow.mjs", "manifest.json", "package.json"]) { copyFileSync("sidecar/src/workflow/generated/" + f, "resources/darwin-arm64/bin/workflow-runtime/" + f); }' && bun build sidecar/src/main.ts --target=bun --outfile resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-agent.js
scripts.build:cli: mkdir -p resources/darwin-arm64/bin && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet ./cmd/valet
